verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review product, so data export and offboarding is a fair axis to judge it on, but the evidence documents no export feature, open-format bulk download, or account exit path. The Analytics API (PR-level metrics), the MCP server (reading findings) and the in-repo cubic.yaml config are adjacent data-access or configuration features, not a capability to export all of your data and leave, so they earn no credit.
